subject: english
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 2.
solution:
The correct answer is '**remarkable**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The passage discusses the impact of child prodigies on societal development.
 
• The appropriate adjective should describe significant or noteworthy changes in society.
 
• "**Remarkable**" fits well as it conveys the idea of extraordinary or significant changes brought by child prodigies.
 
• Other options ("**forgotten**", "**ordinary**", "**professional**") do not align with the context of highlighting exceptional societal changes.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 3**'.
